sources.title: Quickstart: Sentiment analysis and opinion mining
sources.snippet: Use this quickstart to create a sentiment analysis application with the client library for Python. In the following example, you will create a Python application that can identify the sentiment (s) expressed in a text sample, and perform aspect-based sentiment analysis.

sources.title: GitHub - mirzayasirabdullahbaig07/Sentiment_Analysis_Model ...
sources.snippet: An interactive AI-powered web application built with Streamlit that predicts the sentiment of text as positive or negative. This app supports both Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for sentiment analysis.

sources.title: Sentiment analysis prebuilt AI model - AI Builder | Microsoft Learn
sources.snippet: The sentiment analysis prebuilt model detects positive or negative sentiment in text data. You can use it to analyze social media, customer reviews, or any text data you're interested in. Sentiment analysis evaluates text input, and gives scores and labels at a sentence and document level.
